Quotient Quest arenas

These are 6 arenas in the American wilds, with the pixel heroes that you picked. The heroes and the fight screen stay the same. Only the place changes. Tap each arena that you like. You can pick more than one, because each pick can become an arena in the game. Then copy the codes and send them to Claude.

The game draws the health bars and the math buttons with code, so ignore small errors in that text.

B1

Redwood grove at golden hour

The forest from round 5, with deeper light and mist.

B2

Canyon arches at sunset

Warm reds and a big drop behind the fight.

B3

Alpine lake at dawn

Cool blues and pinks, with a calm mirror lake.

B4

Bayou at night

A night arena, with glow from fireflies and mushrooms.

B5

Saguaro desert under stars

A big starry sky with strong shapes of cacti.

B6

Geyser basin in the mist

Bright hot-spring colors and moving steam.
